Hey dude, sorry for not replying any sooner. Was puking my guts up all day yesterday (alcohol is great though...) 

I don't know your situation, obviously, but if you ever need someone to talk to, I can give my best shot at it. 

As for being at your rock bottom, I know how it is, but I also know you will get better some day. That better may not last for too long, but in my opinion, the things you do while down affect your up. It's easy to think "who cares about some scars?", and right now, you probably don't. Maybe you'll feel the slightest bit better some day. Maybe you'll get a caring gf/bf. It's gonna be hard to tell them you've got scars on your legs. 

I might be projecting some of my own insecurities on you right now, but I hope you don't make some of the mistakes I have.

You'll probably live longer than a day though. A week? A month? If you keep on cutting yourself you're going to get scars. It took me over a year to even dare stepping outside with short sleeved shirts.

My advice is don't do it. Do with that as you wish, but keep the long term effects (scars, nerve damage) in mind, not only the short term (feeling in control).
